text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...The crowd is clearing out. Now might be 
my chance to slip into the school 
building—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(...I want to avoid being seen as much as 
possible today. Because...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(It's no wonder if they think an Umamusume 
from Funabashi can't even take care of 
herself...! Ugh... what an idiot I am...!)

Furioso seemed troubled by a sudden skin 
breakout...
